title: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
abstract: arXiv:2611.15789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Controllable real-world video generation models can condition on a rendered graybox proxy video, which fixes layout, motion and camera. Coding agents can build such videos by reconstructing a 4D scene in Blender, yet no benchmark checks both these videos and the long, multi-shot scenes behind them. We introduce VibePrevisBench, a benchmark for 4D scene reconstruction: an agent turns a brief into an executable 4D scene and renders its proxy video. Its 242 tasks span four input kinds, including scripts, photos, continuations, and reference videos. Each delivery is scored along two evaluation dimensions. Rule-based Scene Check re-runs the code and compares the exported 4D scene with hidden ground truth facts in nine dimensions. VLM-based Screen Check asks a VLM judge whether the facts that pass can be recognized in the proxy video. translated_title: VibePrevisBench：评估Blender中4D场景生成的智能体编程能力
translated_abstract: 可控的真实世界视频生成模型可以以渲染的灰盒代理视频作为条件，该视频固定了布局、运动和摄像机。编程智能体可以通过在Blender中重建4D场景来构建此类视频，然而目前尚无基准能够同时检验这些视频及其背后的长篇多镜头场景。我们提出了VibePrevisBench，这是一个用于4D场景重建的基准：智能体将一份简报转化为可执行的4D场景并渲染其代理视频。该基准包含242个任务，涵盖四种输入类型，包括脚本、照片、续写和参考视频。每个交付成果沿两个评估维度进行评分。基于规则的Scene Check（场景检查）会重新运行代码，并在九个维度上将导出的4D场景与隐藏的真实标注进行比较。基于VLM的Screen Check（屏幕检查）则让视觉语言模型评判器判断通过检查的事实是否能在代理视频中被识别。我们分析了11个前沿编程智能体的评估结果与执行轨迹，并识别出三个关键观察。
tldr: 提出了VibePrevisBench基准，通过规则化场景检查与VLM屏幕检查的双重评估体系，系统评估编程智能体在Blender中将简报转化为4D场景并渲染代理视频的能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces VibePrevisBench, a benchmark that evaluates agentic coding for 4D scene reconstruction in Blender through dual evaluation—rule-based Scene Check and VLM-based Screen Check—across 242 tasks spanning four input types.
